name: Conve ~Houkago no Sugoshikata~
source:
Main character establishes a school club with trusted senpai and sincere junior girl to fulfill requests and protect peaceful life. There are several episodes each revealing a challenge that's overcome even despite strict moderation by student council.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角与值得信赖的学长和真诚的学妹一起成立了学校俱乐部，以满足要求并保护和平的生活。有几集每集都揭示了尽管学生会严格调节但仍被克服的挑战。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
